correctness.rationale: Reviewed the actual RESULT.md proof, CHECK.py, SLOGAN.txt, REVIEW.md and administrative source blobs at the assigned Git tree. Define T as unordered K3 count, P as induced 2-edge triples, and W as the sum over vertices of binom(deg(v),2), so P=W-3T. For each fixed triangle, exactly 3 potential wedges reuse 2 triangle edges, 6(n-3) reuse 1, and 3*binom(n,3)-3-6(n-3) reuse 0; for paired triangles 1 is identical, 3(n-3) share an edge, and the others share none. Under G(n,m), with M=binom(n,2) and q_r=(m)_r/(M)_r, these give exact ETW and ET^2 expressions by edge-union sizes 3,4,5 and 3,5,6; subtract ET EW and 3 Var(T). An independently written SymPy derivation from these overlap sums exactly factors to -4*m*(m-1)*(m-2)*(M-m)*(M-m-1)*[(n-1)(n^2-n-4)+m(n^2-3n-8)]/[(n+1)^2(n+2)(M-5)(M-4)(M-2)^2]. The bracket is positive for n>=5 since each coefficient is positive, and for n=4 it is 24-4m>0 at m=3,4; all other factors have the claimed sign for 3<=m<=M-2. At m<=2, T identically vanishes; at m=M-1, P=n-2 deterministically; at m=M, P=0. Under G(n,p), q_r=p^r gives exactly 3*binom(n,3)*p^4*(1-p)*[2(n-3)-(3n-8)p], with threshold 2(n-3)/(3n-8) in (0,1) for all n>=4. An independent exhaustive direct graph census enumerated all 64, 1024 and 32768 labeled graphs for n=4,5,6, matching every fixed-m covariance and the Bernoulli covariance at p=1/5,1/2,4/5. These bounded tests support, but do not replace, the uniform overlap algebra and positivity proof. No claim about negative association or other graph models follows.

value.rationale: Both complete three-vertex motifs and induced open triads are natural network-clustering and transitivity observables. The same pair changes from a sharp sign-changing covariance in G(n,p), with exact threshold p*=2(n-3)/(3n-8), to universal strict negative covariance at every nondegenerate fixed edge count in G(n,m). This comparison gives an exact finite-sample calibration warning that conditioning the edge count changes dependence qualitatively. The complete all-n all-m sign classification is not merely a one-parameter substitution or a small-table enumeration; its sign requires a nontrivial cancellation of mixed triangle/wedge overlap terms. It is a self-contained, motivated invariant, without implying negative association or stronger inference claims.

final_claim: For every n>=4 and 0<=m<=M=binom(n,2), the covariance of unordered triangles T and induced open two-edge triples P in uniform G(n,m) is zero iff m<=2 or m>=M-1 and strictly negative for 3<=m<=M-2, with the factored rational formula stated in RESULT.md. In iid-edge G(n,p), 0<p<1, Cov(T,P)=3*binom(n,3)*p^4*(1-p)*[2(n-3)-(3n-8)p], changing sign at p*=2(n-3)/(3n-8).
limitations: Undirected labeled simple graphs only, n>=4; P counts induced, unordered open 3-vertex paths.
The G(n,m) sign proof uses the uniform fixed-edge hypergeometric model; the G(n,p) formula uses iid edges of common probability.
Covariance does not imply negative association, negative regression or stochastic ordering; no generalization to heterogeneous or regular random graph models.
Novelty is best-of-knowledge: relevant older Janson full texts inaccessible and exact historical priority not certified.
Original publication preparation was incomplete; the historical administrative limitation does not change the mathematical assessment.
